digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate context assembly and verdict finalization
propositions: _assemble_context_uncached swallows child-enumeration and per-child-fetch failures with a bare except Exception and silently continues with an empty or partial children list.

A total enumeration failure flips PlanContext.has_children to False, causing container-scoped DET checks like p5_task_dag and p8_reviewability to return a trivial pass instead of reporting incompleteness.
A container whose hierarchy failed to load can reach an unqualified clean PASS, violating parent epic AC #4 that forbids ordinary clean passes on incompletely loaded hierarchy.
Remediation adds hierarchy_incomplete and hierarchy_incomplete_detail fields to PlanContext, populated via a bounded retry (2 attempts, 50ms delay) around list_tickets and per-child show_ticket.
These flags must be threaded through all five finalize_verdict call sites and the plan-review.yaml coach steps so an incomplete hierarchy yields an INDETERMINATE verdict.

The verdict must remain INDETERMINATE and not revert to PASS after drift-floor and xcheck drop paths recompute the verdict; no relevance-exception carve-out is implemented because the carve-out's trigger condition is unstatable.
